ctx.x: ultimate success. After three years of patient experimenting, Morehouse was able to present his N'goma drums to the music world and public at large. Aside from the fact that N'goma drums are an important innovation to jazz music, they have immense possibilities in symphonic music, according to Irving Mills, music impressario and Morehouse's manager.
